title: Major Update
message:
New
• YouTube Music Library: Adopted YouTube Music as the core library for browsing and streaming music.
• YouTube Music Sync: Sign in to sync your personalized recommendations, listening history, and liked songs.
• Smarter Search: Improved search accuracy to show the closest matches faster without random suggestions.

Fix
• Fixed various bugs and improved overall app performance and stability.

Compatibility
• Android 13 or later is required for this update.
